description: Source code for Google authentication endpoints in a FastAPI application, including OAuth login, callback handling, and One Tap login, with validation and user management.

classes.name: OneTapRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for payload received from Google Identity Services One Tap.

methods.name: dict _verify_google_id_token(id_token: str, client_id: str)
methods.description: Verifies the Google ID token, checks issuer, audience, and email verification.

methods.name: User _find_or_create_user(db: Session, email: str)
methods.description: Finds a user by email or creates a new Google-associated user with a placeholder password.

methods.name: google_login(state: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Opaque state to be returned by Google"))
methods.description: Builds and returns the Google OAuth authorization URL for frontend redirection.

methods.name: google_callback(code: str = Query(..., description="Authorization code returned by Google"), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles Google's callback, exchanges code for tokens, verifies ID token, finds/creates user, and issues app tokens.

methods.name: google_one_tap(payload: OneTapRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Verifies Google One Tap ID token and issues application tokens.

ctags.name: credential
ctags.pattern: /^    credential: str = Field(..., description="Google ID token credential returned by GIS One Tap/

ctags.name: google_callback
ctags.pattern: /^def google_callback(code: str = Query(..., description="Authorization code returned by Google"),/
ctags.signature: (code: str = Query(..., description="Authorization code returned by Google"), db: Session = Depends(get_db))

ctags.name: google_login
ctags.pattern: /^def google_login(state: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Opaque state to be retu/
ctags.signature: (state: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Opaque state to be returned by Google"))
